name: Your Apartment
source:
You wake up in your apartment. You have a feeling today is going to be a great day! ...At least until you realize you're locked inside, that is.

[from [url=https://doodlelogic.itch.io/your-apartment]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你在自己的公寓里醒来，觉得今天一定会是美好的一天！……至少，在发现自己被锁在屋里之前，你是这么想的。

[摘自[url=https://doodlelogic.itch.io/your-apartment]itch.io[/url]]
